paper_title: Dark Matter Search with a Resonantly-Coupled Hybrid Spin System
coupling_convention: gann in GeV^-1 (derivative coupling g_aNN as in H = g_aNN grad(a).I)
notes: K-Rb-21Ne comagnetometer (ChangE collaboration) broadband search in SC and HSR regimes, covering 0.01-1000 Hz Compton frequencies (m_a ~ 4e-17 to 4e-12 eV). Sets 95% CL limits on both gann and gapp; AxionNeutron chosen as primary (strongest laboratory limits, surpassing astrophysics in parts of range). Values are in GeV^-1 (paper's y-axis convention), NOT dimensionless g_an. Data points reconstructed from explicit text statements: |gann| <= 3e-10 GeV^-1 for [0.02, 4] Hz (SC regime); ~3e-9 GeV^-1 flat for [3, 30] Hz (HSR); scaling as fa^2 for [30, 1000] Hz. Full tabulated limits (>10 million points) are in an external data repository [ref 38] not included here, so points are approximate envelope values. Paper also constrains gapp (best terrestrial in [0.02,5] and [16,700] Hz) and quadratic coupling g_quad^2; those are not extracted here.
